title: Brief photos on the agent demo path are cut to each template frame; icons, avatar strips, cut-outs and kept slots stay
steps: S1: From the checkout run: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/wo-agent-demo-slot-fit.test.mjs apps/tracy-host/test/demo-qa-picture-frames.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: plan.save refuses a replace-image row aimed at an icon, an avatar strip, a kept slot or a cut-out, and a phone portrait aimed at a wide card.
media.import with no crop recipe uploads a picture of the frame's shape (704/302 within 0.005) and refuses a portrait for that frame with AGENT_DEMO_IMAGE_DOES_NOT_FIT.
picture-frames-kept fails a box that changed shape or a kept picture that was replaced, and passes photos cut to each frame.
evidence: A demo built from a brief onto a Joomla boxing template had 186 picture boxes change shape over 9 pages: phone portraits placed whole into wide cards, square cards and icon slots, and the avatar strip replaced by one square photo.
fence: The agent demo plan validator and media.import ask the shared picture planner (shapeFit, fitCrop, protectedPicture); the host QA compares each picture box with the baseline's.

tests: no photo replaces an icon, an avatar strip, a kept slot or a cut-out: each row is sent back to retain
a phone portrait never goes into a wide class card; the plan names the photo that fits
media.import cuts the photo to the frame the baseline measured, with no recipe from the agent
a portrait placed whole into a wide card and a photo over an icon or the avatar strip fail, each named
